title: An open map with irreducible fibres induces a bijection on irreducible components
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that an open continuous map whose fibres are irreducible induces a bijection between the irreducible components of source and target (author lemma at source lines 1355-1361, label lemma-irreducible-fibres-irreducible-components). The proof (source lines 1363-1373) notes that the fibres being irreducible makes the map surjective, reduces to irreducibility of the preimage of a component and applies the corresponding fibre statement over that component (proof lines 1363-1372). The reduction to the preimage of a component is the substance. H3.
